<title level="1" right="Class Feature 9">[Debilitating Strike](/Classes.aspx?ID=37)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 164

**Class** Rogue
</column>

---

When taking advantage of an opening, you both hinder and harm your foe. You gain the Debilitating Strike free action.
